messages:
kevin: Quick ask — can infra hold ~20 preemptible H100 80GB nodes in eu-central1 next Tue 09:00-12:00 CET for a latency SLO run? Vendor replied they have a maint window 10:00-11:00 CET. We need either a short guaranteed pool or a soft reservation + predictable eviction window. Ticket: VND-11234.

maya: What's the exact SKU? h100-80? Any wiggle room to A100 if H100s aren't available?

kevin: Yes h100-80. We prefer H100 for perf parity with Dedicated, but A100 fallback is acceptable (perf delta ~6-12%).

ingrid: Quota check — current spare capacity in eu-central1 is only 12 H100s, so we're short. I'll kick off a quota request now, but vendor hold will likely be faster. pinging vendor-bot.

vendor-bot: Vendor notice: Planned maintenance in eu-central1 on 2026-03-24 10:00-11:00 CET affecting network fabric on racks 4-7. Affected SKUs: h100-80, a100-80. Reference VND-11234.

sam: If vendor can't hold for a single 20-node pool, we can stage 20 nodes across eu-west1 + eu-central1 (10/10) to avoid single-rack impact. Slightly more noisy but workable for latency comparisons.

lucas: Cost FYI — 20 x h100-80 preemptible ~ $18.5/hr (rough estimate) for that window. If we get preemptions we'll need to stretch the test timeline.

maya: Can we request a soft reservation (vendor "hold") for 12 nodes and open a quota bump for the additional 8? Ingrid, can you paste the quota request link when it's up?

ingrid: Filed quota request: https://console.cloud.google.com/quotas?project=redwood&ticket=Q-7891 — asked for +16 h100s in eu-central1. ETA 48-72h.

kevin: I'll reply to the vendor ticket asking for a hold for 20 nodes between 09:00-12:00 CET and request they avoid scheduling maint during that window if possible. If they can't shift, propose alternate window 07:00-10:00 CET. @maya @sam any blockers for an earlier start?

maya: Early start ok for eng. :thumbsup: 

sam: OK for tests, but will need to flag overnight ops. I'll add a runbook note and ping oncall.

deploy-bot: Notice: scheduled job 'latency-harness' created for 2026-03-24T07:00:00Z by kevin.

kevin: Sweet. I'll update VND-11234 with the proposed hold + alternate window and post vendor response here.

lucas: Also consider a cheap fallback of 20 x a10g if we suffer mass H100 preemptions — lower perf but much cheaper to secure quickly.

kevin: Noted. Thanks all — will keep updates in this thread.
